## E2 — M1 host boot: FAILS at configureDns (read-only rootfs vs NixOS resolv.conf symlink), 2026-07-15

`container machine run -n hermes-spike` → boot aborts BEFORE systemd starts:
`failed to bootstrap container hermes-spike (cause: "configureDns")`. No stdio.log produced (never reached init).

**Isolated the cause** by booting Apple's own alpine machine (`alpine-probe`): it boots and runs commands (uname 6.18.15, resolv.conf present) — so the machine MECHANISM works. Two facts from alpine:
1. **Apple's machine rootfs is READ-ONLY** even for alpine (`touch /rwtest` → Permission denied → ROOTFS-RO). Confirms E2's flagged unknown: machines do NOT give a writable rootfs.
2. Yet alpine's `/etc/resolv.conf` WAS written by Apple (nameserver 192.168.72.1, domain machine) — so Apple has a writable path/overlay specifically for the files it configures (resolv.conf/hosts/hostname), and it works when those are **regular files**.

**Root cause**: NixOS makes `/etc/resolv.conf` a **symlink into the read-only `/nix/store`** (or /run). Apple's `configureDns` tries to write it, the write follows the symlink to a read-only/absent target, fails → boot aborts. This is the read-only-rootfs incompatibility, surfaced narrowly at DNS injection.

**Implication for the wholesale path**: even with resolv.conf fixed, a standard NixOS boot runs systemd activation that writes /etc, /var, /run — all read-only under an Apple machine. A booting NixOS image needs (a) resolv.conf/hosts/hostname as regular mutable files, and (b) tmpfs overlays on the writable paths so activation succeeds. That's a real image iteration, not an apple/container blocker.

**Gate status**: the sandbox-path gate is ALREADY satisfied by E1 (socktainer chain PASS). E2 is the bonus "keep NixOS wholesale" alternative — so this is not gate-critical. Making one scoped fix attempt (rebuild M1 with mutable resolv.conf + tmpfs /etc,/var,/run overlays) on hermes; if it needs deep rework, E2 records as "wholesale-NixOS boots blocked by read-only-rootfs; fixable with more image work, deferred; E1 carries the gate."
